description: EMBOSS 6.6.0 megamerger: merges two large overlapping DNA sequences by exact word matches (600 random related / unrelated pairs equal: merged sequence and report text). All exact matches of wordSize symbols (the maximal matches of seqmatchall) are ordered longest first and reduced to a minimal non-overlapping set: the longest is kept, matches inside its dead zone are dropped, those crossing it are truncated (dropped when shorter than the word), until none is left; the kept matches are ordered by position. The merged sequence = the part before the first match (from the sequence whose overlap starts at its own start; when neither does the longer prefix, upper case), the matches (first sequence, lower case), between matches the region of the sequence whose mismatch is farther from its ends (preferFirst: always the first sequence), upper case, and the part after the last match (the longer remainder in upper case when neither overlap is at an end). The report lists every overlap start / end, mismatch region and choice as the program writes it. A second sequence shorter than the word or without a match gives an empty merge; a first sequence shorter than the word (or without a word free of N) is an error (the program stops with 'No match found'). Note: this merges by anchors; the overlap merge of two short sequences by dynamic programming is the merger tool. Input sequences are read as EMBOSS reads them (A4-3, one shared reader): only letters and '*' are kept; gap characters (- . ~ ?), '#', '+', '_', digits, blanks and every other character are dropped first, and positions, lengths and scores count the cleaned sequence (e.g. needle of AC-GTTAGC.TT* and ACGTTAGCTT: score 58, length 11, as the program).

preferFirst.description: Use the first sequence over every mismatch region (megamerger -prefer, default false).

name1.description: Name of the first sequence in the report.

name2.description: Name of the second sequence in the report.

mergedSequence.description: The merged sequence (empty when nothing was merged).

report.description: The text of the megamerger report file.

matches.description: The minimal set of anchoring matches `{ sequence1, sequence2, position1, position2, length }` (0-based starts) ordered by position.

errors.message: Sequence cannot be null or empty
The first sequence has no word of N symbols: megamerger stops with No match found
